scope: Controlled PAC execution of unchanged self-contained Darwin explicit scalar, 128-bit integer, one/two-word record and f32/f64 HFA calls, including register exhaustion, packed fixed stack placement, and whole aligned variadic values. Default promotions apply to scalar tails; HFA members retain their original widths. Supplied prototypes, not automatic complete recovery. Indirect copies/results, arbitrary records, authenticated whole images, native Apple execution, signed exception unwinding and exact fault PC/ESR remain unqualified.
changes: Explicit Darwin AArch64 variadic prototypes retain complete direct 128-bit, word-record and f32/f64 HFA values, including fixed aggregate prefixes and spills.
Unnamed objects use whole eight-byte stack slots with higher natural alignment and original member offsets; scalar i128 uses its 16-byte ABI alignment rather than the architecture-neutral type cap.
LLVM C checks every actual operand, including unnamed arrays, for ordinary C calling convention, ABI attributes, supported shape and scalar default promotions.
The public SDK native oracle calls separately compiled C va_arg readers using the actual emitted entry prototype; original assembly and both C projections execute at O0/O2.
Model objects are prepared once per route. The complete copied ELF text must equal the original Mach-O bytes before any guest links; entries and hashes remain recorded per input.
